title: Lesson 6: À l'hôtel
description: A hotel check-in dialogue for greetings, room reservations, names, agreement, floors, keys, and luggage.

notes.1: Bonsoir, good evening, is the formal greeting used after 6 pm.
notes.2: Remember that the definite article l' replaces le or la in front of a word beginning with a vowel or an h. Un hôtel is masculine.
notes.3: Le nom means the name. The word generally refers to a person's surname, the proper term for which is le nom de famille, family name. Le prénom, literally pre-name, is the term for the first name.
notes.4: Grand is an adjective meaning big or large. Adjectives agree with the gender of the noun they qualify, so we say un grand lit, a large bed, but une grande chambre. You see now why learning noun genders is so important.
notes.5: Here's another type of agreement: pronouns also need to change depending on whether the noun is plural or singular. Vos is the plural of votre: votre nom, your name, but vos bagages, your bags.

lines.french: Bonsoir monsieur, bonsoir madame. Bienvenue à l'Hôtel Molière.
parts: monsieur, bonsoir madame. Bienvenue à l'Hôtel
lines.english: Good evening, sir; good evening, madam. Welcome to the Molière Hotel.

lines.french: Bonsoir, nous‿avons une chambre réservée pour deux nuits.
parts: Bonsoir, nous‿avons une chambre réservée pour deux nuits.
lines.english: Good evening, we have a room reserved for two nights.

lines.french: Quel‿est votre nom, s'il vous plaît ?
Je m'appelle Bailly : B-A-I deux‿L-Y. Alain.
parts: Je m'appelle Bailly : B-A-I deux‿L-Y. Alain.
lines.english: My name is Bailly: B-A-I-double-L-Y. Alain.

lines.french: Absolument : une grande chambre avec‿un grand lit et une salle de bains.
parts: Absolument : une grande chambre avec‿un grand lit
lines.english: Absolutely: a large room with a double bed and a bathroom.

lines.french: C'est‿au quatrième étage. Voici la clé.
parts: C'est‿au quatrième étage. Voici la clé.
lines.english: It's on the fourth floor. Here's the key.

tests.title: Exercice 1 - Traduisez
tests.instructions: Listen, then rebuild the French sentence in order.

items.english: Your room is on the sixth floor. Here's the key.
Is your surname Bailly? Absolutely. My first name is Alain.
I have a room reserved for three nights.
